subject.title: [Bug]: Docker Install + Sandbox can't workspaceAccess at all

question: Should OpenClaw add a validated host-path remapping contract for Docker Gateway/DooD sandbox managed mounts, or require identical host/container path mapping as the supported contract with better diagnostics?
rationale: This choice changes sandbox bind-source trust boundaries, Docker install compatibility, setup docs, and possible config or doctor behavior, so automation should not select the permanent contract.

options.title: Define Secure Remapping Contract
options.body: Add or sponsor validated host-path mapping for managed workspace, agent workspace, materialized skill, browser, and custom bind paths with schema/docs/doctor coverage and live DooD proof.

options.title: Keep Identical-Path Contract
options.body: Document and enforce that Docker Gateway deployments must mount the same host path inside the Gateway container, then add doctor or setup diagnostics for mismatched deployments.

options.title: Land Narrow Skill Repair Only
options.body: Treat the open materialized-skills PR as a partial repair while leaving this canonical workspaceAccess issue open for the broader managed-mount contract.

recommendation.title: Define Secure Remapping Contract
recommendation.body: Add or sponsor validated host-path mapping for managed workspace, agent workspace, materialized skill, browser, and custom bind paths with schema/docs/doctor coverage and live DooD proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They marked this item canonical and have the strongest current discussion plus current-main blame signal on the relevant sandbox/DooD files.
